title.original: Agent Memory: Characterization and System Implications of Stateful Long-Horizon Workloads
title.zh: 代理内存：状态长时间工作负载的表征和系统影响
title.en: Agent Memory: Characterization and System Implications of Stateful Long-Horizon Workloads

inclusion_reason.zh: 四轴 taxonomy 与阶段感知 profiling harness 为 Agent 记忆提供可复用的系统比较和容量规划基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: The four-axis taxonomy and phase-aware profiling harness provide reusable systems-comparison and capacity-planning infrastructure for agent memory.

abstract.zh: 该工作首次从系统角度刻画 Agent 记忆，提出四轴分类，并构建按构建、检索、生成阶段归因成本的 profiling harness。作者在两套基准上比较十个代表系统，分析设计选择如何把开销在写路径和读路径之间转移。
abstract.en: This work presents a systems characterization of agent memory, introducing a four-axis taxonomy and a phase-aware profiler that attributes cost to construction, retrieval, and generation. Ten representative systems are compared across two benchmark suites to reveal read/write-path trade-offs.

problem.zh: 平面检索、LLM 抽取、事实巩固和 Agent 控制等记忆架构快速涌现，但其构建、查询、生成成本与新鲜度权衡缺少统一系统测量。
problem.en: Flat retrieval, LLM extraction, consolidating fact stores, and agentic control have proliferated without a common characterization of construction, query, generation cost, and freshness trade-offs.

approach.zh: 研究先用四个轴统一描述记忆系统，再以阶段感知 harness 分离写入构建、召回和回答开销，并在相同基准条件下横向运行十种系统。
approach.en: The study first describes systems through four common axes, then uses a phase-aware harness to separate write construction, recall, and answer cost while running ten designs under shared benchmark conditions.

system_design.zh: profiling harness 在记忆构建、检索与生成边界插桩，记录延迟与成本并关联体系结构特征；分析层据此比较写读转移、查询摊销和新鲜度策略。
system_design.en: The profiler instruments construction, retrieval, and generation boundaries, associates latency and cost with architectural features, and compares write/read shifting, query amortization, and freshness policy.

key_results.zh: 跨十个系统的刻画揭示不同设计把成本移向写路径或读路径的方式，并导出关于构建调度、能力下限、查询量摊销、新鲜度—时延和集群管理的十条建议。
key_results.en: The characterization reveals how designs shift cost between write and read paths and derives ten recommendations spanning construction scheduling, capability floors, query-volume amortization, freshness–latency, and fleet management.

limitations.zh: 结论取决于所选十个系统、两套基准和当时实现版本；安全、隐私、正确性和跨租户资源争用并非摘要中测量的主要维度。
limitations.en: Conclusions depend on the selected ten systems, two benchmarks, and implementation versions; safety, privacy, correctness, and cross-tenant contention are not primary measured dimensions in the abstract.

baselines: 10 systems spanning flat retrieval, LLM extraction, consolidating stores, and agentic control

notes.zh: 十个系统、两套基准、三阶段画像和十条建议来自官方摘要；系统/基准名称、硬件和逐阶段成本待全文审计。
notes.en: Ten systems, two suites, three profiling phases, and ten recommendations come from the official abstract; system/benchmark names, hardware, and per-phase costs await full-text audit.
